input.question: Two trains start 300 km apart and travel toward each other on the same track, one at 70 km/h and the other at 80 km/h. After how many hours do they meet?
A bat and a ball cost 1.10 dollars in total. The bat costs 1.00 dollar more than the ball. How many cents does the ball cost?
5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets. How many minutes do 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
A patch of lily pads doubles in size every day. It takes 48 days to cover the whole lake. After how many days does it cover half of the lake?
Today is a Wednesday. What day of the week is it 100 days from today?
Is the year 2100 a leap year in the Gregorian calendar? Answer yes or no.
What is the sum of the first 50 positive odd numbers?
12 people are at a meeting. Each person shakes hands exactly once with every other person. How many handshakes happen?
A price goes up by 20 percent and then the new price goes down by 20 percent. The final price is what percent of the original price?
Sally is a girl. She has 3 brothers. Each of her brothers has 2 sisters. How many sisters does Sally have?
What is the smaller angle, in degrees, between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 3:15?
You have 10 litres of a solution that is 30 percent salt. How many litres of pure water must you add to make it 20 percent salt?
If you write every whole number from 1 to 100, how many times do you write the digit 7?
How many times does the letter r appear in the word strawberry?
Pipe A fills a tank in 3 hours. Pipe B fills the same tank in 6 hours. With both pipes open, how many hours does it take to fill the empty tank?

How many days are there from 6 January 2018 to 30 January 2030? Count each day after the first date up to and including the second date, so the number of days from 1 March to 2 March is 1. Use the Gregorian calendar.

How many days are there from 27 March 2021 to 27 September 2029? Count each day after the first date up to and including the second date, so the number of days from 1 March to 2 March is 1. Use the Gregorian calendar.
26 June 2020 was a Friday. What day of the week is 16 September 2026? Use the Gregorian calendar. Answer with the name of the day.
20 May 2019 was a Monday. What day of the week is 9 December 2025? Use the Gregorian calendar. Answer with the name of the day.
In the Gregorian calendar, how many 29 February dates occur from 1 January 1896 to 31 December 2115, both days included?
In the Gregorian calendar, how many 29 February dates occur from 1 January 1875 to 31 December 2113, both days included?

A reservoir holds 170 litres at time 0 and has a capacity of 4179 litres. From time 0, pump A adds 59 litres per minute, and a leak removes 12 litres per minute for as long as the reservoir is not empty. Pump B adds 33 litres per minute and is switched on 7 minutes after time 0. After how many minutes from time 0 is the reservoir exactly full?

A reservoir holds 160 litres at time 0 and has a capacity of 2161 litres. From time 0, pump A adds 54 litres per minute, and a leak removes 13 litres per minute for as long as the reservoir is not empty. Pump B adds 24 litres per minute and is switched on 6 minutes after time 0. After how many minutes from time 0 is the reservoir exactly full?

A tank holds 80 litres of a solution that is 35 percent acid by volume. 20 litres of the solution are drained and replaced with 20 litres of pure water, and the tank is stirred well. Then 16 litres of the new mixture are drained and replaced with 16 litres of pure water, and the tank is stirred well again. What percent acid is the final mixture?

A tank holds 40 litres of a solution that is 45 percent acid by volume. 10 litres of the solution are drained and replaced with 10 litres of pure water, and the tank is stirred well. Then 8 litres of the new mixture are drained and replaced with 8 litres of pure water, and the tank is stirred well again. What percent acid is the final mixture?

A club has 8 members: 4 seniors, including Ana and Ben, and 4 juniors. A committee of exactly 5 members is chosen. It must contain at least 3 seniors, and Ana and Ben refuse to serve on the committee together (either one alone is fine). How many different committees are possible?

A club has 12 members: 6 seniors, including Ana and Ben, and 6 juniors. A committee of exactly 5 members is chosen. It must contain at least 2 seniors, and Ana and Ben refuse to serve on the committee together (either one alone is fine). How many different committees are possible?
How many three-digit whole numbers (from 100 to 999) have three different digits, are divisible by 6, and do not contain the digit 8 anywhere?
How many three-digit whole numbers (from 100 to 999) have three different digits, are divisible by 8, and do not contain the digit 6 anywhere?

A rope is 56 feet 11 inches long. 1 foot is exactly 12 inches and 1 inch is exactly 2.54 centimetres. The rope is cut into pieces that are each 37 centimetres long, and a leftover piece shorter than 37 centimetres is thrown away. How many pieces of 37 centimetres are cut?
A train travels at a constant speed of 95 kilometres per hour. How many metres does it cover in 14 minutes and 42 seconds? (1 kilometre is 1000 metres.)
What is the remainder when 8^152 + 2^347 is divided by 17? (Here 8^152 means 8 multiplied by itself 152 times.)
What is the remainder when 2^94 + 5^360 is divided by 11? (Here 2^94 means 2 multiplied by itself 94 times.)

Three lights flash at 08:00 all at the same moment. After that, the first light flashes every 6 minutes, the second every 20 minutes and the third every 25 minutes. Counting the flash at 08:00 as the first, how many times do all three lights flash at the same moment from 08:00 until exactly 31 hours later? Both of those two moments are included.

Three lights flash at 08:00 all at the same moment. After that, the first light flashes every 10 minutes, the second every 15 minutes and the third every 30 minutes. Counting the flash at 08:00 as the first, how many times do all three lights flash at the same moment from 08:00 until exactly 32 hours later? Both of those two moments are included.

A job needs 376 tiles to be laid. Ana lays 28 tiles per hour and Ben lays 8 tiles per hour, and each works at a constant rate. Ana starts alone. After 3 hours Ben joins her. After the two have worked together for 7 hours, Ana leaves and Ben finishes the job alone. How many hours pass from the moment Ana starts until the job is finished?

A job needs 275 tiles to be laid. Ana lays 17 tiles per hour and Ben lays 11 tiles per hour, and each works at a constant rate. Ana starts alone. After 6 hours Ben joins her. After the two have worked together for 5 hours, Ana leaves and Ben finishes the job alone. How many hours pass from the moment Ana starts until the job is finished?

A jacket is priced at $150. The shop first raises the price by 30 percent. Then a sale lowers that new price by 40 percent. Then a coupon lowers the sale price by a further 15 percent. What is the final price in dollars? Give the exact value.

A jacket is priced at $230. The shop first raises the price by 25 percent. Then a sale lowers that new price by 20 percent. Then a coupon lowers the sale price by a further 25 percent. What is the final price in dollars? Give the exact value.

A data plan has a fixed monthly fee of $20. Usage is billed per whole gigabyte: the first 3 GB cost $4 per GB, the next 5 GB cost $8 per GB, and every GB after those costs $13 per GB. A tax of 20 percent is then added to the whole amount (the fee plus the usage charges). A customer uses 11 GB in a month. What is the total bill in dollars?

A data plan has a fixed monthly fee of $21. Usage is billed per whole gigabyte: the first 4 GB cost $2 per GB, the next 7 GB cost $4 per GB, and every GB after those costs $10 per GB. A tax of 10 percent is then added to the whole amount (the fee plus the usage charges). A customer uses 14 GB in a month. What is the total bill in dollars?

A courier rides 210 km from town A to town B at a constant 24 km/h, rests 30 minutes in town B, and then rides back along the same road at a constant 10 km/h. How many minutes pass from the moment the courier leaves town A until the courier is back in town A?

A courier rides 140 km from town A to town B at a constant 15 km/h, rests 35 minutes in town B, and then rides back along the same road at a constant 25 km/h. How many minutes pass from the moment the courier leaves town A until the courier is back in town A?

A class of 12 students has a mean test score of 76. 6 of the students, whose scores have a mean of 59, are then removed from the data because they retook the test. One new student with a score of 86 is added to the remaining students. What is the mean score of the students in the data now?

A class of 25 students has a mean test score of 83. 5 of the students, whose scores have a mean of 51, are then removed from the data because they retook the test. One new student with a score of 70 is added to the remaining students. What is the mean score of the students in the data now?
